title: Top CSK Target Players for the 2025 Auction
content:
Top CSK Target Players for the 2025 Auction

5 players CSK Can target in 2025 mega auction

CSK Auction Strategy

#1

Glenn Phillips

Glenn Phillips, as the name goes, does more than just score runs. Many times, his outstanding fielding abilities have changed matches in the team’s favour.

2

Nitish Rana

It is improbable that Nitish Rana, an excellent middle-order batter, will be retained by the Kolkata Knight Riders (KKR) in the upcoming mega auction.

#3

Dhruv Jurel

Dhruv Jurel, the wicketkeeper-batsman who hails from India, sizzles as one of the viable selections for the playing XI of CSK in terms of steadiness and finishing power.

#4

Liam Livingston

Livingstone being a power-hitting batsman able to hit sixes at his will gives CSK the much-required firepower in the batting order.

#5

Mitchel Marsh

In 2025, Mitchell Marsh becomes a very attractive option for CSK’s roster as he has a valuable amount of experience and leadership qualities.
